# The wasm profile uses the installed toolchain with no external
# tool: with PATH holding only the toolchain bin directory (no C
# compiler, linker, or wasm tool), logos build and go build still emit
# the wasm output and its loader, and the loader still runs under node.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
env ORIGPATH=$PATH
env PATH=$GOROOT/bin

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/logos.wasm .
exists $WORK/logos.wasm
exists $WORK/logos.loader.mjs
cp $GOROOT/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js $WORK/wasm_exec.js
go build -o $WORK/plain.wasm .
exists $WORK/plain.wasm
exists $WORK/plain.loader.mjs

# Recording fakes for common external wasm tools sit first on PATH:
# neither build may invoke any of them, and both outputs must match
# builds without the fakes.
env LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER=$WORK/tools-ran.log
chmod 0755 $WORK/faketools/wasm-opt $WORK/faketools/wasm-ld $WORK/faketools/wasm-strip $WORK/faketools/wasm2wat $WORK/faketools/binaryen
env PATH=$WORK/faketools:$GOROOT/bin
logos build -o $WORK/fake-logos.wasm .
go build -o $WORK/fake-plain.wasm .
! exists $WORK/tools-ran.log
cmp $WORK/fake-logos.wasm $WORK/logos.wasm
cmp $WORK/fake-plain.wasm $WORK/plain.wasm
[!exec:node] skip 'A-NODE: node is required to run the loader'
env PATH=$ORIGPATH
exec node ../run.mjs $WORK/logos.wasm $WORK/logos.loader.mjs
stdout '^noextool-ok$'
exec node ../run.mjs $WORK/plain.wasm $WORK/plain.loader.mjs
stdout '^noextool-ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/noextool

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import "unsafe"

//go:wasmimport host add
func hostAdd(a, b int32) int32

//go:wasmexport incr
func incr(p unsafe.Pointer, n int32) int32 {
	b := unsafe.Slice((*byte)(p), n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i]++
	}
	return 0
}

//go:wasmexport checkHost
func checkHost(a, b, want int32) int32 {
	if hostAdd(a, b) != want {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func main() {
	select {}
}

-- run.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

const [wasmPath, loaderPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
const loader = await import(pathToFileURL(resolve(loaderPath)).href);
assert.equal(typeof loader.instantiateLogos, "function");
const { exports } = await loader.instantiateLogos(readFileSync(wasmPath), {
	host: { add: (a, b) => a + b },
});
const input = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]);
exports.incr(input);
assert.deepEqual(input, new Uint8Array([2, 3, 4]));
exports.checkHost(2, 3, 5);
console.log("noextool-ok");

-- $WORK/faketools/wasm-opt --
#!/bin/sh
echo "wasm-opt $@" >>"$LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER"
exit 0

-- $WORK/faketools/wasm-ld --
#!/bin/sh
echo "wasm-ld $@" >>"$LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER"
exit 0

-- $WORK/faketools/wasm-strip --
#!/bin/sh
echo "wasm-strip $@" >>"$LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER"
exit 0

-- $WORK/faketools/wasm2wat --
#!/bin/sh
echo "wasm2wat $@" >>"$LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER"
exit 0

-- $WORK/faketools/binaryen --
#!/bin/sh
echo "binaryen $@" >>"$LOGOS_WASM_TOOL_MARKER"
exit 0
